evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the try/except at lines 781-787 wraps only self.push, while the post-push self.fetch at line 788 is outside it. A fetch failure in the same handled exception classes therefore escapes publish() without setting last_error and without taking the break path to the pending-publication IntegrityError, leaving the batch unacknowledged and the remaining groups unattempted. Moving the fetch into the try block is the smallest compatible fix and does not change successful behavior.
